reason: The prior governance conflated frozen research-package defects with external orchestration/transport/substrate failures. This allowed failures in a newly-added GitHub Actions wrapper and hosted-runner startup to exhaust the same repair budget intended to prevent repeated mutation of the frozen research package, even though the exact frozen BuildOnly runner never executed.

RESEARCH_PACKAGE.definition: Frozen runner, lock, schemas, manifests, QA tool/fixtures, package provenance, scientific design bindings.

ORCHESTRATION_TRANSPORT.definition: Workflow YAML, CI wrapper, artifact upload/download glue, shell invocation wrapper, transport-only code outside the frozen package.
ORCHESTRATION_TRANSPORT.constraint: May change only while frozen package blobs and science design remain exact and no scientific outcome has been exposed.

EXECUTION_SUBSTRATE.definition: GitHub-hosted Windows runner, local Windows workstation, shell/toolchain availability, runner provisioning and platform startup.
EXECUTION_SUBSTRATE.constraint: Alternate substrate must be preregistered, must execute the exact frozen package, and must not mutate scientific design.

SCIENTIFIC_EXECUTION.definition: Target-model load, diagnostic scientific executable, GPU dispatch, performance timing, fresh TTFT observations, mechanism adjudication.

infrastructure_close_permitted_only_if_o: A frozen research-package defect budget is exhausted after actual execution reaches the frozen runner/package.
All preregistered viable execution substrates have been attempted and independently shown unavailable or unusable without mutating the frozen package.
A substrate qualification gate concludes no viable substrate exists for the exact frozen package.
The operator explicitly terminates the research program.
forbidden_close_basis: Failure of a newly-added orchestration wrapper before the frozen runner starts.
Failure of one hosted execution substrate when another viable preregistered substrate exists.
Absence of logs from an external executor without attempting another viable substrate.

local_windows_workstation.rationale: ArcLLM is developed and previously executed on the user's Windows workstation; PowerShell and repository-local toolchain execution are natural for the frozen .ps1 BuildOnly runner.

continuation_path.p8l_scope: Pull exact amended branch on local Windows, verify frozen bindings and P7 authorization, invoke exact frozen run_ttft_m2_buildonly.ps1, return generated evidence bundle/report.

anti_rescue_boundary.statement: This amendment corrects infrastructure governance only. It does not rescue a scientific outcome because no scientific outcome exists.

general_rule: Governance constrains scientific degrees of freedom and preserves falsifiability; it must not treat unrelated transport/orchestration/substrate faults as scientific-package failures or prevent use of another preregistered viable substrate when the frozen research object is unchanged.
